title: Financial Services Compensation Scheme of Last Resort Levy Bill 2022
short_title: Financial Services Compensation Scheme of Last Resort Levy Bill 2022

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would impose financial industry levies to fund a compensation scheme of last resort for eligible unpaid financial complaints determinations and related scheme costs.
It would provide annual and additional levies, generally limited to $250 million across the scheme and $20 million per sub-sector, with specified flexibility for sub-sector limits.
The Commonwealth would meet first-year operating costs, while companion legislation would establish the compensation scheme and arrangements for collecting levies from financial firms.
changes: An annual levy would fund estimated compensation, unpaid complaints fees, reserves and administration.
Further levies could address revised cost estimates within the applicable sub-sector cap.
Special levies could apply where a ministerial determination addressed funding beyond a sub-sector cap.
A separate initial levy would fund accumulated claims and fees through the ten largest eligible banking and insurance groups.
summary.affected: Financial firms in prescribed sub-sectors and eligible large banking and insurance groups would be affected.
